root_cause.text: Missing validation that the directory entry record length (reclen) does not exceed PAGE_SIZE before copying it into the page-cache page, allowing a malicious FUSE server to supply an oversized namelen that causes a buffer overflow in fuse_add_dirent_to_cache().
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states the function "never checks whether the dirent itself exceeds PAGE_SIZE" and that a namelen of 4095 produces a reclen of 4120 bytes, which on 4 KiB pages overflows the cache page by 24 bytes via memcpy(). The patch adds a check `if (reclen > PAGE_SIZE) return;` to reject such oversized dirents.
